document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
By a stroke of luck, your party stumbles upon an abandoned 
cabin stocked with rusty but edible tins of food. This happy 
discovery solves your food problem for the time being. There 
is  no  trace  of  the  person  who  built  the  cabin—probably  a 
prospector or hunter who fell victim to the hazards of the valley.

You may make an improvement check for your Luck score to gain 
1D10 Luck points. Go to 77.
